column1: #   Light-verb "N + ккезе" (harm/trouble/benefit falls on someone): affectee takes DAT -е
#     NOT SUPESS. Attested: зарал ккезе X-е 'harm befalls X'
column2: къварилъи ккезе X-е 'trouble for X'.

column1: #   Light-verb "N + буго" (intention/hope/opportunity): possessor in GEN -л/-ул/-ир (дир ният буго).
#     When the intender is also subject of a matrix verb of saying
column2: the GEN can be omitted

column1: #     and the intender identified via apposition/ERG.
#   Quotative frame: "[CLAUSE]-ин/-илан абуна [AGENT-ERG]" with embedded clause verb in finite form.
#   Attributive "as.if" frame: "[CLAUSE] гӀадин буго" REQUIRES participle on clause's auxiliary
#     so past-negative copula is букӀинчӀеб (III ptcp)
column2: NOT букӀинчӀо (finite). Contrast with the

column1: #     quotative frame above
column2: which does take the finite form.

column1: #   Comparative "[X] гӀадин" takes the case of the matrix argument it parallels (NOT always ABS):
#     - Adverbial manner ("does X as Y does"): X matches the shared verb's subject/experiencer case
#         e.g. 'Дуда гӀадин ... Томида кӀвелароан' (both SUPESS via кӀвезе).
#     - Attributive on head noun ("an X like Y"): Y is ABS
column2: гӀадин takes class agreement with the

column1: #         head noun
column2: e.g. 'мун гӀадинав багьадур' (like-you.I hero.I).

column1: #     - Attributive "as.if-clause": '[CLAUSE-PTCP] гӀадин буго' — clause-level
column2: no NP case at all.

column1: #   Irrealis conditional: protasis -арабани / -чӀебани
column2: apodosis PRS/FUT + -аан (see notes.md §1.2).

column1: #   "never" in NEG clause: киданиги + NEG verb (e.g. киданиги кӀвеларо / кӀоченаро); avoid calques.
#   "almost X" idiom: [subj-ABS] [X-INF] дагьалъ хутӀана (dict: 'чуть не упал' = 'ккезе дагьалъ хутӀана').
#     Subject of the embedded INF is ABS
column2: not SUPESS
column3: even if the verb normally takes SUPESS subj.

column1: #   Temporal "N units ago": unit in ERG + цебе (анкьалъ цебе
column2: къоялъ цебе); bare ABS is wrong.

column1: #   бокьизе 'want/love': PRS.PTCP.III is бокьулеб (not бокьунеб
column2: which is ungrammatical).
